items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Her last job was at Lutchen's with Big I and Winnes Rodgers.

ctx.x: Well she worked with different men. She worked a while with the Renny and she worked a while with Arnaud to Pets. She worked with different fellas. Her last job was at Lutchen's with Big I and Winnes Rodgers.

Yeah, I should've seen her. I was wondering about clarinet players again, here to change the subject a little bit. Some of the very first you heard and who were your favorites when you were a boy that you followed in the street? It inspired you. You say you wanted to take up clarinet. Who was the first one you thought was so good that you liked the instrument?
